collection.title: Toyota Proace Van With Split Rear Doors 2016 to 2023 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Toyota Proace 2016 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Bayonet arm attachment.
